aboutContent.title: I'm Erica
aboutContent.subtitle: Luxury Proposal & Wedding Planner, Marrakech
aboutContent.body:
I'm Erica, a luxury proposal & wedding planner based in Marrakech, passionate about creating elegant and unforgettable experiences inspired by the beauty of Morocco.

With over 10 years of experience in luxury events, I specialize in romantic proposals, elopements, and intimate celebrations thoughtfully designed around each couple's vision. From the Agafay Desert to private riads and rooftops, every detail is carefully curated to create authentic, emotional, and timeless moments.

Together with my team, we combine creativity, organization, and attention to detail to transform your special occasion into a truly memorable experience.
